review.gallery: 6 Nshama design renders and 2 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. The image shared with Berkshire’s thumbnail was excluded. Lexington uses its own Plot 95 renders.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 8 and 6. The project pin is from Continental Club’s project 3364 listing and aligns with the marked plot sector. The separate reused locator in the page schema was excluded.
review.floorPlans: 12 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. Both total columns for 2 BR Type F print 944.43 sq ft. The selector shows that figure once. The drawings retain the individual component figures.
